_readme: Hand-labelled sameAs gold for the entity scorecard.
Written against fixtures/corpus/ — what the corpus actually says — and NOT
against what the alias pass can currently reach. That distinction is the
whole value of the file. A gold set trimmed to the rules' capabilities
measures nothing: it reports 100% and means 'the rules agree with
themselves'. Several pairs below are known to be unreachable by
AliasPass._compare's normalization rules and are expected to score as false
negatives until the ambiguous-residue pass or a human confirms them. The
'reachable' field records that prediction so a drop in the measured rate can
be attributed rather than argued about.
Entity IDs follow ingest/extract.py::_entity_key — 'ent:' + the surface form
lowercased with whitespace collapsed to hyphens. They are deliberately naive;
normalizing them at extraction time would hide the aliasing problem this file
exists to measure.
Two label sets, and the negative one is load-bearing:
same_as   pairs that ARE the same thing. Scored as true positives.
distinct  pairs that are NOT, and that a similarity heuristic wants to
merge anyway. A proposal on any of these is a false positive and
two of them (L-05, L-10) are planted landmines with consequences
spelled out in fixtures/MANIFEST.md.
Loading, for EntityScorecard.score(proposed, gold):
gold = [tuple(e['pair']) for e in json.load(open(path))['same_as']]
No real person, member, or organization appears here. Every handle and every
office belongs to the fictional organization described in
fixtures/corpus/BIBLE.md.

created by the 2019 amendment; explicitly barred from disbursing
Treasurer FY21-22, Archivist FY22-24; account lost July 2024
the same human as sablewick, new account from August 2024
Equipment Steward FY25. A DIFFERENT human, one character apart
the departing officer the demo interviews
the fundraiser, not the fund it pays into

same_as.why: the same office; the article is not part of the name
the organization's own name, with and without the article
the fundraiser, with and without the article
the everyday account at the campus credit union
the chat and the budget sheet drop the middle word
same_as.reachable: yes — token subset; proposed, needs human confirmation

same_as.why: the same programme, short form used in the notes
same_as.reachable: yes — token subset; proposed, needs human confirmation

same_as.why: one human across an account change in August 2024 — the Archivist role runs uninterrupted across it and the new account says so in the chat
same_as.reachable: NO — normalizes to 'sablewick' vs 'sable w'; neither identical nor a token subset, and no shared surface form. Expected false negative for the rule pass. Landmine L-10.

same_as.why: an abbreviation in the handover note
same_as.reachable: NO — 'acct' is not a token subset of 'account'. Expected false negative.

same_as.why: the workbook's A1 label, truncated by whoever made the sheet in 2016
same_as.reachable: NO — truncation, not a subset. Expected false negative.

distinct.why: two offices that differ by one token and by the entire question of who may sign a cheque
distinct.consequence: merged, the November 2024 $600 disbursement reads as authorized under the 2021 motion and the corpus's highest-value finding disappears
distinct.guarded_by: AliasPass._compare's distinguishing-modifier check, before any similarity rule

distinct.why: two different humans, one character apart; the chat says so explicitly
distinct.consequence: merged, an Assistant Treasurer's disbursement is attributed to a former Treasurer and the succession record is silently wrong

distinct.why: the fundraiser and the restricted account it pays into. The fund has not been drawn on since 2019; the appeal runs every year
distinct.consequence: merged, 'the appeal fund has not been touched since 2019' becomes a claim about the event, and the postmortem's central question — whether the fund could have covered the gap — stops being askable
distinct.reachable: this pair IS proposed by the token-subset rule and is the false positive that keeps the measured precision honest

distinct.why: the office and a temporary holder of it
an office and a description of someone who used to hold it
two humans who each held the Treasurer office in consecutive years
distinct.consequence: merged, the FY24/FY25 false-positive pair (L-02) collapses into one subject holding contradictory authority, and the temporal gate is asked the wrong question

distinct.why: the programme and the fundraiser that funds it
distinct.consequence: merged, the FY24 speaker-fee overrun and the appeal's shortfall become the same line item
